name: doom-band
description: Real DOOM in the band above the prompt: /doom starts the doomgeneric engine (WebAssembly, Freedoom) and draws its frames with kitty graphics while Claude plans or codes.

wad.title: IWAD path
wad.description: Absolute path of your own DOOM IWAD (doom1.wad, DOOM.WAD, DOOM2.WAD). Leave empty to download Freedoom phase 1 on first start.

fps.title: Frames per second
fps.description: How many frames per second reach the terminal. The engine always runs at 35 Hz.
